title: Foreign Selling Deepened. Technology Led the Fall.
deck: Primary IDX data show Rp5.04tn of foreign net selling, eleven falling sectors, a 40% drop in GOTO and who took the other side.

sections.title: Four declines and an unconfirmed bounce

blocks.text: The IHSG fell 3.28% to 6,036.888 while IDX statistics recorded Rp5.04tn of foreign net selling, with all five sessions net sales. That is 59.6% more than the previous week's Rp3.16tn. The index declined for four sessions before Friday's 27.386-point gain, and foreign investors sold a net Rp1.27tn into that rise. The price steadied without flow confirmation.

blocks.label: 01 / THE PRICE PATH
blocks.title: Four lower closes, then a small rebound

sections.title: Foreign selling on all five days

blocks.text: Wednesday's Rp1.61tn was the largest daily net sale, 32.0% of the week. The weekly IDX table also shows Rp3.16tn of net selling in the previous week; this week's Rp5.04tn was 59.6% more. Year to date, IDX records Rp82.55tn of foreign net selling; this week alone accounts for 6.1% of it.

blocks.label: 02 / FOREIGN FLOW
blocks.title: Selling in every session, heaviest on Wednesday
blocks.note: Daily net foreign stock purchases, Rp bn. IDX reports the weekly total as −5,036.31; the displayed daily figures sum to −5,036.32, a Rp0.01bn difference at published precision.

blocks.text: IDX's transaction table splits each trade by the seller's and buyer's domicile. Foreign investors sold Rp14.19tn of stock to domestic buyers and bought Rp9.15tn from domestic sellers; the difference is the Rp5.04tn net sale, and it reconciles day by day with the daily statistics. Domestic investors were therefore the net buyers: Rp39.99tn bought against Rp34.96tn sold. Foreign investors' share of weekly trading value rose from 34% to 41%, but Rp13.98tn of the week's value, 22.1%, changed hands between foreign accounts and moved no money across the domestic and foreign line.

blocks.caption: Trading value by seller and buyer, 28 September to 2 October (Rp bn)

blocks.text: Wednesday stood out on both counts. Foreign-to-foreign trades reached Rp4.23tn, 30.1% of that day's value against about 20% on each of the other four days, and the same session carried the week's heaviest net selling. The table records domicile, not motive, so it cannot show whether those trades were block transfers or ordinary dealing.

Average daily volume rose 72.51% from the previous week while average daily value rose 5.40%. This week's stock trading value divided by shares traded was Rp250.65 per share. On Friday GOTO traded 99,890 million shares, 82.77% of the day's volume; Friday's 120,681 million shares were 47.9% of the week's total. Excluding GOTO, Friday's 20,791 million shares were fewer than any other day's total, and Friday's value of Rp12.25tn was close to the week's daily average.

Eight of IDX's ten weekly top losers, GOTO among them, began the week at Rp50 and ended between Rp24 and Rp33. IDX's statistics do not give a reason. Separately, the negotiated market accounted for 13.83% of the week's trading value (Rp8.73tn).

blocks.caption: Weekly top losers that began the week at Rp50

blocks.text: Of 963 stocks in IDX's breadth breakdown, 559 (58.0%) fell over the week and 224 (23.3%) rose. Stocks that fell more than 2% represented Rp6,256tn of market capitalisation, 59.2% of the total in that breakdown, against Rp2,482tn in stocks that rose.

No sector index finished the week higher. Technology fell 12.45%, more than twice the next-worst sector, basic materials at 5.29%. Energy held up best at 0.99% lower. Price performance establishes where losses were taken; it does not identify who sold.

blocks.label: 03 / WEEKLY SECTOR RETURNS
blocks.title: The full-week ranking
blocks.note: These are sector-index price returns, not contributions to IHSG points.

sections.title: GOTO took the largest share of the decline

blocks.text: IDX's index-mover table attributes 36.71 negative IHSG points to GOTO alone, 17.9% of the index's net 205.004-point fall, as its price dropped 40% from Rp50 to Rp30. GOTO, AMMN and TLKM together account for 70.59 points, about a third of the net decline. The three largest positive contributors, DSSA, UNTR and VKTR, added 16.37 points.

GOTO also contributed to Friday's rebound: it rose 7.14% that day and added 3.70 of the IHSG's 27.386-point gain, according to the 2 October daily report. It still finished the week as the index's largest negative contributor.

sections.title: A weak region, a weaker IHSG

blocks.text: Every ASEAN index in IDX's comparison fell. The IHSG fell further than every ASEAN peer except the Philippines' PSEi. Of the 32 other indices in the table, only four fell more, and four rose, led by Japan's Nikkei 225 at 2.93% and Brazil's Ibovespa at 2.03%.

JISDOR eased 0.11% between the two Fridays, from 17,917 to 17,898, so the rupiah slightly softened the equity loss for an unhedged dollar investor. Within the week the rate ranged from 17,877 on Wednesday to 17,998 on Tuesday. The reference-rate timing differs from the equity close, so this is an indicative comparison rather than an executable return.

The latest policy decisions before the week were Bank Indonesia's 23 September hold of the BI-Rate at 5.75% and the Federal Reserve's 16 September increase of its federal funds target by 0.25 percentage point to a range of 3.75% to 4.00%. Neither release identifies the cause of this week's equity moves.

blocks.title: The currency barely moved the result

blocks.label: Tactical stance
blocks.text: Defensive; hold back new broad exposure until daily foreign selling eases and more than one sector recovers. Judge participation by trading value rather than share volume, which low-priced stocks inflated this week. For unhedged dollar investors the currency was close to neutral; the equity price did the damage.

First, a rising session with foreign net buying; this week had none, and Friday's gain came with Rp1.27tn of net selling. Second, breadth: this week 434 stocks fell more than 2% and 144 rose more than 2%, and a recovery worth trusting would reverse that ratio. Third, technology, the sector that fell most, steadying without one stock's volume carrying the day. Fourth, daily value holding near this week's Rp12.6tn average while those signals appear.
Monitoring references and scenarios are not statistically validated support or resistance and carry no assigned probabilities.

method: Returns are price returns. Rp bn means billion rupiah; Rp tn means trillion rupiah. IDX classifies foreign investors by the domicile entered into its trading system, not necessarily ultimate beneficial ownership. The seller-to-buyer table sums the rounded buyer-seller cells for five days; its Rp63,127bn total differs from the exact weekly value of Rp63,125.87bn. Value per share traded is weekly stock trading value divided by weekly volume, both from IDX's trading recapitulation. Breadth shares are computed from IDX's counts. The JISDOR-based USD return excludes dividends, fees, taxes, hedging and tracking costs.
